claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will take place from April 23–25 in Pittsburgh, PA.
The 2026 NFL Draft features 257 picks over seven rounds.
The 2026 NFL Draft is held around Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park.
The Las Vegas Raiders hold the first overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft begins on April 23 at 8 p.m. ET.
Coverage of the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft is on ESPN, ABC, and NFL Network.
The location of the 2026 NFL Draft is Pittsburgh, PA (North Shore and Point State Park).
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on April 23.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on April 24.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on April 25.
The first-round pick time in the 2026 NFL Draft is reduced to eight minutes (formerly 10).
The New York Jets have the second overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The Arizona Cardinals have the third overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The Tennessee Titans have the fourth overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The New York Giants have the fifth overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The Cleveland Browns have the sixth overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The Washington Commanders have the seventh overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The New Orleans Saints have the eighth overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The Kansas City Chiefs have the ninth overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The Cincinnati Bengals have the tenth overall pick in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
The NFL draft order is determined by the previous season's record in reverse order.
